title: Meet the Records
description: Recognize one customer record, its identifier, and its descriptive fields.

title: Read an Order
description: Distinguish one sales order from its two lines and check the amount without counting the header twice.

title: Connect the Records
description: Use customer and item keys to add descriptions while preserving one row per order line.

title: Follow a Goods Sale
description: Trace a released goods line from order to shipment and invoice with Excel or simple SQL.

title: Follow Customer Settlement
description: Compare cash receipts and invoice applications at two dates and explain the remaining balance.

title: Find the Accounting Entries
description: Connect selected business events to complete ledger vouchers and explain their debit and credit effects.

title: Follow Design Time into Billing
description: Reconcile approved time to one service billing period and distinguish revenue from time-cost support.

title: Follow a Purchase
description: Follow a receipt-matched purchase through GRNI, supplier invoicing, and a payment after year end.

title: Follow Manufacturing Costs
description: Separate material issue, standard-cost completion, and the later close of one work order.

title: Follow Hours into Payroll
description: Reconcile approved hours and net pay while distinguishing employee payment from period-wide remittances.

title: Follow an Estimate into Settlement
description: Trace an expense estimate to its supplier invoice, residual adjustment, and later payment.

title: Turn Records into a Conclusion
description: Build a monthly invoice summary and turn a checked result into a bounded business conclusion.
